reviews.title: Tinder-Hinge clone but without access
reviews.text: This Tinder-Hinge clone asks a lot of questions before you can create a profile but then, it doesn’t allow you to chat with people without paying. Why use it?

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: You cannot even message a match without paying!!

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: The feature section suggests that once you match with a member, you can message them for free. However, this isn’t actually the case—you still need a paid membership to message someone you’ve matched with. So, in reality, messaging isn’t free at all, and the wording is misleading

reviews.title: Messages not being delivered
reviews.text: If I use the online version all my messages are marked delivered, however if I use the app my messages only say sent and continue to remain red.

reviews.title: Advertised as free
reviews.text: Many sites advertise this as free. It ain’t, but they suck in all your personal data. I am changing every password as we speak. Avoid

reviews.title: Dreadful
reviews.text: Difficult to cancel

reviews.title: Just awful
reviews.text:
Good grief, this is the most depressing ap I’ve ever been on. It makes Tinder look good! The men are not only miles away and incapable of reading a profile that says clearly I’m not interested in long distance and please,  if I get up 2 hrs before work, shower, moisturise and put on stylish clean clothes and pop on some makeup .. the very least you can do is brush your hair, and take a decent picture. Some look like they only wash once a month and are probably the ones who moan they never get a response !! 
I’ve asked for a right of withdrawal because the men on this ap are absolutely not worth paying to see, and it creeps me out thinking they can see me. What’s even worse is having paid £19:99 for a week, to actually control who sees you they want ANOTHER £9:99, how is that even safe!!! After less than 24hrs on this ap I know why women in their 50s end up with much younger men and i will never have any guilt doing the same in future, or staying single for that matter. If this ap were a house I’d be wiping my feet in the way out !

reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text:
I think this is a great app for meeting people. It’s very frustrating and sad, therefore, that the lack of response and support from customer services lets this app down. I paid my subscription but only a couple of features work. I can reply to messages but cannot read them. Despite many messages to customer support over the past week giving them all the technical information they requested, I am
Now being ignored. Paying for six months for something I can’t use…

reviews.title: Dreadful customer service and attitude to privacy
reviews.text: Extremely difficult to understand how to stop your profile photo being emailed to everyone in your area every day as part of OurTime’s marketing. Customer service completely failed to clarify how to do this, even suggesting that I would need to pay £9.99 PER MONTH to achieve this. Impossible to escalate my query or make a complaint — these requests were completely ignored. I recommend looking at Trustpilot for reviews of this company before using this app.

reviews.title: Why?
reviews.text: I just don’t understand. I joined the Match app and now it transfers me to an almost exact copy. So which app should I use? Very weird

reviews.title: Appalling customer support
reviews.text: Customer support completely unable to answer basic questions about their own service. Also recommend looking at their reviews on Trustpilot where they score 1/5 — seems a lot more realistic.

reviews.title: Date site
reviews.text:
I have sent numerous emails asking for my subscription to be cancelled but they still keep taking my money 
So hard to get help 
Unless you want to subscribe for ever don’t sign up

reviews.title: App responsiveness could be better.
reviews.text: Been on the app for about a week. Seem to be real people here so that’s a bonus. The issue seems to be with messaging. I get alerts that people have viewed, liked or messaged however when opening the app, nothing. It could be up to 30 minutes before it appears. When in ‘talking’ to someone, the conversation becomes stunted as messages can take ages to come through. Not what you want when trying to start building relationships.

reviews.title: Fake profiles
reviews.text: More fake profiles than tinder. You’ll see the same faces again and again. Save your money.

reviews.title: Access Denials and No Customer Support
reviews.text:
It is unclear if there is an app issue or the platform that supports it but I’ve two accounts with this organisation, both with a fully paid subscription and have been blocked by OurTime on both occasions with no explanation (their own T&C’s state they have to tell you why). The app directs you to customer services where the actual contact email is buried. I’ve raised ticket after ticket, got receipts for these but no replies even though their own SLA says a response should come in 24h. Payments are still being taken but service continues to be denied. I’ve emailed them one last time to ask for a resolution after which time I will cancel the PayPal payments. The app also regularly crashes and you have to shut it down and reboot it. Overall very poor and don’t recommend either the app or OurTime as a platform.

Edit: Thank you to the developer for their response but customer services don’t respond to my tickets.

reviews.text: If you have TLS error check you have parental controls with your network provider are off. As for OurTime? I'd don't thing my languague would make it pass the moderators. 90% of contacts are scams...

reviews.title: Buggy, poorly designed and frustrating
reviews.text:
Firstly I'm sure many of the profiles are fake.
It's hard to know, but that's the feeling I got.
Also the app stopped working and I got an “invalid status error” and then.unable to recover my account. No explanation what that error means… simply doesnt work.
And then trying to login from a fresh install… same problem. Grrrrr :(

Really frustrating and disappointing.
Also no dates from the site. I'm not a great catch… but I don't think I'm undateable 😆
Quite soul destroying experience for a number of reasons…. And I'm paying for it!!!!

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: They make you get the app so that you can delete your account, but then surprise surprise, the delete account button is the one that just throws up an error message. All part of the scam to make people think there are more users than there really are I guess.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: This app can go ages without any problems, but at the moment it’s rubbish.  I’m constantly getting failed to load messages, despite deleting and reinstalling. Probably something to do with iOS update, but still, keep up!

reviews.title: Flakey platform - beware …
reviews.text: This platform is very flakey, often won’t let you log in or fails to load when you do… they seem to have people on who are running older versions with different formats to the latest. Elements you complete don’t seem to carry over to the new version… it’s generally quite frustrating to use. Plus even with a subscription they always want more money for what are pretty basic features, none of which would be bad if you could actually load the app consistently….

reviews.title: January Update
reviews.text: What have you done to the App? Out of service for one day whilst upgrading - I’ll await the credit!  Now it won’t load and says “it’s not you, it’s me”. No email apology or credit. It now prefers portrait, which is not what I (or my Smart Keyboard) prefer. This is no longer for me… Update - they have come back to me ‘saying’ I can contact them by following this link, which leads to an empty screen or I can update my review. Shocking…. A contactless organisation. No clear links to be able to say I have a problem. Happy to take your cash though…

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text:
Latest update is a huge backward step for users but I totally get why match CORPORATION (let’s be honest guys) has made it. Distances from you removed, smaller pics - all designed to make you click more and feed that need (check out the recent documentary). Really glitchy on top of everything. Getting alerts about likes and looks that just aren’t there when I log in. Already disheartened with the app experience this has done nothing to keep me here (or more likely accelerated my deletion). 
Good luck everyone.

reviews.title: New Update messed it up
reviews.text: Since the new update I can’t view new matches. It asks me to reload then says it’s failed. Looks like a bug needs ironing out then back to 4*

reviews.title: Awful .. don’t waste your money
reviews.text:
Lots of profiles of people who are no longer members. The app has updated and now doesn’t work as it should and won’t allow me to access parts that I have paid for . If you unsubscribe to stop the next payment going out of your account a few weeks in advance the site then classes you as a non member. 
There are a lot of scam profiles you should be careful of too .

reviews.title: Absolute rubbish update
reviews.text: Whilst not pretty the app served its purpose relatively well. However this update 21 jan 26 is just rubbish, app takes forever to load. Crashes ( it’s not my connection) I can’t see when people viewed my profile, I font care if someone is online now, I do however care how far away they are from me. The search feature is returning zero matches yesterday same search  returned 500 results. It is far too easy to like someone accidentally. All in all not happy at all with the upgrade which at the end of the day I’m paying a lot to use.

reviews.title: Latest update has ruined everything
reviews.text:
My password on the App no longer works, so can't get logged in via the App. 
I CAN log in on the website (with the same username and password) but all my searches are coming back with "No Profiles Found" which means there is nobody over the age of 61 within 226 miles of me (and I live slap bang in the middle of the country). 
"Highlights" page just hangs with a spinning wheel thing. 
"Discover" page is blank
"Likes" and "Matches" looks like they might be working ok, except that "Matches is showing me conversations not matches !
Overall - it's not good - and worst of all I've paid for a load of rubbish.

reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.text: Another scam of a website, I chose this online dating site because it showed me I had a number of suitors, people who had already liked me.   But you can’t see the data, information or pictures until you pay them your money.   Once I paid, I found out at least 50% of the profiles had been deleted by OurTime because they were fake or inappropriate profiles, but they leave the empty profiles on to increase their numbers, leading you into false beliefs!  Now trying to find how to delete my subscription, as they make this as hard as possible as well!!
